title: GrainError
description: Grain -> RepairOS: the body of every 4xx (400 bad input, 401/403 auth, 404 not found, 409 busy or no build, 413 too large). The sentence says what to send instead. Pinned against the private recorded Grain fixtures (e.g. a scan name without its extension, a photo referenced by id). Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.
